intro: A Computer Science student specialising in Software Engineering, building mobile applications with Flutter and looking for an opportunity to grow.
about: I’m studying Computer Science at Universiti Malaysia Sabah, with a focus on Software Engineering. I’m interested in how thoughtful interfaces, application logic and data come together to make useful software.
My current projects include HerbaSabah and Pengajian AM STPM Objektif. I’m looking for an internship where I can contribute, learn from experienced engineers and keep improving.
